dz: 法蒂米德将军乔哈尔以卡利夫·穆伊兹·利-丁·阿拉为名领导了富斯塔特的星期五祈祷会,从而象征性地完成了法蒂米德对埃及的征服.
de: The Fatimid general Jawhar leads the Friday prayer in Fustat in the name of Caliph al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah, thereby symbolically completing the Fatimid conquest of Egypt.

t: 拜占庭帝国从阿拉伯统治下收复了安提俄克.
te: The Byzantine Empire recovers Antioch from Arab rule.
dz: 拜占庭帝国从阿拉伯统治下收复了安提俄克.
de: The Byzantine Empire recovers Antioch from Arab rule.

dz: 拜占庭皇帝尼克福罗斯二世·波克斯被他的妻子西奥潘诺和她的情人,后任皇帝约翰一世·齐米斯克斯所暗杀.
de: Byzantine Emperor Nikephoros II Phokas is assassinated by his wife Theophano and her lover, the later Emperor John I Tzimiskes.
